author: Reel FX Animation
title: Reel FX hiring matte painting artists for Doctor Dolittle
content: Let your talent run wild! Reel FX Animation is looking for Matte Painting Artists to work on wonderful environments for our 3D feature Doctor Dolittle: King of the Wild. Tools: Maya, Nuke, Photoshop, After Effects. Location: Montréal, 3 days/week in studio. Start date: ASAP. Apply and show your portfolio: https://careers.reelfx.com/apply/823?language=en

author: Glow Production
title: Glow Production hiring game character artists
content: Glow Production is expanding our Game Division and looking for artists at all levels. Now hiring: Animator; Rigging Artist; Game Artist - Lighting & Technical Art; Character Artist - Hair Specialist. Location: Petaling Jaya, Malaysia (on-site). Language: professional proficiency in Mandarin and English. Apply: glow-production.com/career/game

author: Asymptote Journal
title: Asymptote seeking guest illustrators and designers
content: Asymptote is seeking designers and guest artists. We are looking for imaginative designers to join our international team, as well as guest artists interested in shaping the look and atmosphere of a single issue. We are also inviting illustrators to collaborate on a single quarterly issue, working alongside the editorial team. Interested? Attach a cover letter to your portfolio and send an application to editors@asymptotejournal.com.
